{{actor|name=ovl_En_M_Fire1|ispage=true}}

'''ovl_En_M_Fire1''' is the actor that manages the [[Deku Nut]] attack. When Link begins to toss a Deku Nut, it actually begins as an {{actor ref|0016}} spawn, before the Arrow actor spawns the Deku Nut actor.
